sources.citation: L. S. Bovkun et al., Physical Review Materials 9, 054602 (2025)
sources.title: Topological phase diagram of mercury cadmium telluride quantum wells

specimen_series.material: Hg1-xCdxTe quantum wells in Hg0.3Cd0.7Te barriers on CdTe
specimen_series.x_calibration: Cd/Te flux ratio calibrated against 75 nm Hg1-xCdxTe layers by XRD under Vegard-law modeling
specimen_series.thin_qw_xrd_limitation: direct XRD composition extraction was not feasible for the approximately 10 nm wells because of weak signal
specimen_series.thickness_precision: plus or minus one atomic layer

near_critical_constraints.paper_statement: for x greater than 0.054, the beta transition exceeds alpha at all fields, anticrossings disappear, and a direct trivial gap opens

usable_constraints: sample-specific thicknesses with monolayer-scale XRR precision
composition calibration chain and its thin-well limitation
model broadening convention that must not be treated as a measured STS kernel

sources.citation: X. Biquard et al., Journal of Synchrotron Radiation 28, 181-187 (2021)
sources.title: Submicronic Laue diffraction to determine in-depth strain in very closely matched complex HgCdTe/CdZnTe heterostructures with a 10^-5 resolution

specimens.substrate: 4 cm x 4 cm (211)B CdZnTe with approximately 4% Zn
configurations: same-wafer material after 5 h thermal annealing under Hg pressure
composition_methods: SIMS depth profiling for as-grown and annealed samples
STEM-EDX on a less-than-100-nm lamella for the dual-band stack

measured_kernel.beam_fwhm_inferred_from: Hg fluorescence transition at the abrupt layer/substrate interface
measured_kernel.strain_sensitivity: plus or minus 1.3e-5 in the annealed-sample substrate region

quantitative_findings: as-grown strain transition from zero substrate strain to approximately -2e-4 in the layer occurs over about 600 nm, matching the beam FWHM
annealed-interface composition-derived strain agrees with micro-Laue after SIMS data are convolved with the 580 nm pseudo-Voigt kernel
dual-band STEM-EDX profiles are convolved with the same measured 580 nm kernel before comparison with strain
the paper resolves depth-dependent strain and composition gradients, not stationary lateral alloy covariance

limitations_for_r04_r05.geometry: cross-sectional depth profiles rather than two-dimensional lateral maps
limitations_for_r04_r05.spatial_band: 580 nm FWHM is slightly coarser than the preferred 10-500 nm design range

usable_constraints: directly measured spatial kernel rather than nominal beam size
explicit convolution of higher-resolution chemical profiles before modality comparison
methodological warning that depth composition gradients and lateral covariance are different observables

sources.citation: Q.-Y. Wang et al., Journal of Infrared and Millimeter Waves 31, 222-225 (2012)
sources.title: Scanning tunneling spectra for the etched surface of p-type HgCdTe
abstract_level_constraints: LPE p-type HgCdTe was etched in 3% bromine-methanol for 2.5 minutes
submicrometer pits had apparent depths from tens to hundreds of nanometers
flat-region spectra showed apparent gaps larger than the bulk gap because of tip-induced band bending
pit spectra had finite slope through zero from dense in-gap states
sources.reason_non_blocking: the independently ingested 2012 APL companion paper already establishes the same tip-induced band-bending, pit-state, and non-geometric-topography safeguards with more quantitative detail

remaining_decisive_gaps: two-dimensional lateral composition or signed-gap covariance on a near-critical specimen
measured local low-energy spectroscopy from the same specimen population
same-population linkage between covariance and local spectroscopy

stop_rules: Do not combine the Bovkun near-critical QW series, Biquard cross-sectional detector profiles, and Zha STM specimen into one synthetic specimen.
Do not treat the Bovkun k.p Gaussian broadening convention as a measured energy-resolution kernel.
Do not treat the Biquard 580 nm depth kernel as evidence of 10-500 nm lateral covariance.
Do not treat SIMS or STEM-EDX depth gradients as a lateral correlation length.
Do not reactivate R05 from improved priors or instrument-method constraints alone.
